thread:
hannah: Heads-up: PR ready to land that documents model-aliasing and updates SDK snippets. Need reviewers @ben @lucy and merge before docs cutoff Fri Oct 2 23:59 PDT. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3021.

ben: I'll take a look this afternoon. Does this change any public URLs?

hannah: It moves the examples from /guides/models/aliasing -> /guides/models/aliasing_v1 and adds a short migration note. Plan is to add a 301 redirect for the old url.

lucy: Quick ask: keep the unversioned sidebar unchanged until the FF ramp. Add the new page under versioned v2026-10 only.

ci-bot: preview: initial build failed - missing asset /static/images/alias-flow.svg (404). Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/99999/logs.

hannah: Oops, missed that when moving files. Pushing the svg into /static/images and fixing the markdown path now.

ben: Also, add a single-line migration blurb for release notes: "Model alias keys renamed; old keys supported behind FF `ff.model.alias.v1` for 7 days."

hannah: Added the blurb to the PR description and included a tiny sed-based helper in the PR body.

ci-bot: preview: rebuild complete. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-3021--redwood-docs.netlify.app. All checks passed.

lucy: Reviewing now. Left two nits: 1) code fence language for the ruby example, 2) mention exact FF name in the migration note (ben already suggested).

hannah: Fixed both nits, squashed commits, rebased on main.

docs-bot: merge/plan: propose merge Thu Sep 30 09:00 PDT to allow ~48h canary before cutoff. SRE to monitor link health and preview metrics.

ben: Sounds good to me. No objections. Lucy?

lucy: Approved. Will monitor staging for missing assets and verify the redirect after prod deploy.

hannah: Thanks all 389 After merge I'll post the migration snippet to #support and add the change to the release notes.

docs-bot: merged: PR3021 merged into main at 2017002600. Staging deploy started.
